family_reports.body: Ignored false reports, ignored the law and my children barely see me. The judges and attorneys now let my little girls be prescribed anti depressants. My children are begging for more time with me and the judges don't care. 13 false reports to CPS and the judges ignore the evidence. CPS has testified for me that my ex is the one refusing to co parent and coaching the children to speak bad about dad. Judge didn't care.
This judge does not follow the law. She is bias and does not truly care about the best interest of the child m.

Family of veterans forever changed by the effects of a broken corrupt system that left behind traumatized children forever impacted by a childhood they will have to heal from. Affected by a system that fancies falsified narratives, unproven evidence, stolen time and memories, pushes for and ignores disability accommodations and protections and promotes preteen attempted suicide. A system so corrupt they only care about funding , not best interest of the child. We gave our lives they stole our children's childhoods.

The system has not protected my children from an abusive parent who also disclosed to a coparenting facilitator that he has been engaging in alienating parent activities like trying to win over the kids and talking bad about me and my spouse to the kids. Judge was only concerned with safety of our children’s father’s dog instead of our children and took his attorneys word for it that dog situation was taken care of. It wasn’t.
